summary: Horseless Carriage is a heavy economic game from the designers behind Antiquity and Food Chain Magnate, casting players as early automobile manufacturers speculating on parts, demand, and factory tech trees. It's long, mechanically dense, and rewards careful reading of a fluctuating commodity market over multiple hours.
praised: deep, satisfying economic simulation of an emerging industry
strong sense of building up a manufacturing empire over time
criticised: very long playtime for a niche audience
market-based scoring can be opaque to new players
limited table availability/print run makes it hard to find

interaction.kind: private factory building around a shared speculative market
interaction.detail: Each player expands their own car factory through tile placement on a personal board, so construction itself isn't shared, but everyone buys and sells raw materials on one common, price-fluctuating market, meaning heavy buying or selling by one player changes the price everyone else pays. Turn order is set by comparative performance rather than by acting on another player's pieces directly.

scoring.how_you_win: You design, manufacture, and sell cars while speculating on the market for parts and stock; the player with the most money when the game ends wins.
